issues.explanation: Here 曾 means “once/formerly,” not the surname Zeng.
In 装病, 装 means “to pretend/fake,” not “adornment.”
The gloss is dictionary metadata and does not explain 岁 in 二十岁.
北部尉 is a historical official title, so splitting it as 北部 plus 尉 hides a useful lexical unit.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 北部尉 as one word, meaning "Northern District Commandant".

issues.explanation: 五色 is a natural word meaning “five-colored/multicolored”; splitting it into 五 and 色 obscures that compound.
issues.suggested_fix: Annotate 五色 as one word, meaning "five-colored; multicolored".

issues.explanation: 大震 is not a lexicalized idiom here; it is the ordinary degree-plus-verb phrase in 威名大震.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 大 ("greatly") and 震 ("to spread/become widely known" in this context).

issues.explanation: The gloss is an opaque dictionary cross-reference rather than a learner-facing place-name explanation.
With 被诬陷, 下狱 means “be sent to prison/be imprisoned,” not transitive “to imprison.”
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: "to be imprisoned; be sent to prison"

issues.explanation: In 刘备三人, 三 means the number “three,” not the surname San.
Here 突然 functions adverbially and means “suddenly,” rather than the adjective “sudden.”
In 因三人是白身, 三 means the number “three,” not the surname San.
In 因……而……, 而 links cause and result, meaning roughly “and thus/consequently,” not simply “and.”
In 怒而要杀他, 怒 means “to become/be angry,” not the noun “anger.”
In 怒而要杀他, 而 indicates the following action or consequence, roughly “then/and so,” not just “and.”
